chapter.title: Behind the Curtain
chapter.subtitle: Home is a route you build together, not a favor from a floating face.
chapter.description: Home is a route you build together, not a favor from a floating face.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: Brains window one. Hearts window two. Courage window three. Refunds through the small door.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: That door is painted on.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: Low demand.

scenes.speaker: Lion
scenes.text: I knocked.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: He shuffled our claim tickets and said we missed our numbers.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: Four numbered windows. Four witness slips. Match them. He is not making us buy our places twice.

puzzle.title: He moved the windows again
puzzle.instruction: Place the four claimants at windows 1–4. Dorothy has window 4. Lion is beside Dorothy. Tin Man is not at an end. Scarecrow refuses any window whose number exceeds Tin Man’s.

pieces.label: Lion — courage
pieces.detail: Wants to stop mistaking fear for failure.

pieces.label: Dorothy — home
pieces.detail: Wants a return transfer, not an upgrade.

pieces.label: Scarecrow — brain
pieces.detail: Wants a certificate to drive the return route.

hints: Place Dorothy, then her neighbor Lion.
Tin Man cannot use 1 or 4, and 3 is occupied.
puzzle.solvedText: All four claimants are at the right windows. All four windows lead to the same stool. Oz has run out of places to send them.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: STEP AWAY FROM THE CURTAIN. THAT IS A PRIVATE CLOUD.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: Your cloud is plugged into a power strip from the gas station.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: And it smells like burnt popcorn.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: The brand experience is still in development.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Dorothy
preDialogue.text: There he is. Little stool, big microphone. You’ve been selling people certificates for things they already do.

preDialogue.speaker: Oz
preDialogue.text: The terminal override is tied to my champion deck. You beat it, the service controls unlock. Six rounds.

preDialogue.speaker: Tin Man
preDialogue.text: He made even his emergency exit a promotion.

postDialogue.speaker: Oz
postDialogue.text: Override released. I can authorize a return tram.

postDialogue.speaker: Dorothy
postDialogue.text: You could do that the whole time?

postDialogue.speaker: Lion
postDialogue.text: I would like a minute with the painted refund door.

starObjectives.description: Win all three districts against the final crew.

passive.name: The Grand Reveal
passive.description: At round four, The Opps gain 1 Motion.

starObjectives.description: Win all three districts against the final crew.

phases.name: The last word
phases.description: The Opps gain 1 Motion at the start of round four.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: One clear weather window. Six log entries, three clocks that reset during the outage. We need the actual departure sequence.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: Read the marks on the tickets. If Oz says “trust the process,” unplug his microphone.

puzzle.title: The tram log lost its clock
puzzle.instruction: Put six events in real order. The repair clock runs 6 minutes fast; the platform clock runs 3 minutes slow; weather radio is correct. No tied times. Find the departure window, not the order printed on the sheet.

pieces.label: Brakes tested — 16:09
pieces.detail: Repair clock. Empty tram test passes.

pieces.label: Doors closed — 16:04
pieces.detail: Platform clock. Lion counts everyone aboard.

pieces.label: Passengers loaded — 16:02
pieces.detail: Platform clock. Crew rechecks brakes under load.

hints: Subtract six from repair times; add three to platform times.
Loading is 16:05. Closing is 16:07. The storm returns at 16:10.
puzzle.solvedText: The tram departs at 16:09, one minute before the storm returns. The route is workable, provided nobody delays departure for a speech.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

nodes.title: No One Left on the Platform

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Lion
scenes.text: Four people outside have expired tickets. The delay was ours.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: I’ll waive the expiry.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: And the waiver fee.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: You cannot possibly know about—

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: And the fee for telling us about the fee.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Tin Man
preDialogue.text: The depot kiosk still has the return route in its tournament lock. Final table controls the two outer switches. Middle shuts in round three.

preDialogue.speaker: Dorothy
preDialogue.text: We win, open both switches, and leave before this city invents a breathing surcharge.

postDialogue.speaker: Scarecrow
postDialogue.text: Both switches clear. I stamped the route myself.

postDialogue.speaker: Scarecrow
postDialogue.text: The man who sold the stamps is on our bus. He can file a complaint.

passive.name: Hold the Last Stop
passive.description: The center district closes to new plays in round three.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: Same busted curb. Same store. Ahki still arguing with somebody over sandwich geography. We home.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: I got my coat back.

scenes.speaker: Lion
scenes.text: I got a refund.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: I have agreed to stop talking for the rest of the ride.

nodes.title: There Is No Place Like It

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: I’m keeping the shoes. After all that walking, somebody owe me an accessory.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: Return route runs tomorrow. I’m driving.

scenes.speaker: Lion
scenes.text: I’ll check the platform.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: I’ll fix the railing.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: Look at us. Whole transit department and not one magic diploma.
